name: Nematode-feeding mites
description: Mites specialized on hunting nematodes - root-feeders, bacteria-feeders, fungus-feeders and omnivores alike ('nematophagous mites' in the source). Functional group aggregating the nematode-feeding mite species, measured together by the source. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in kg C per hectare, yearly average, from Table A1 of van Altena et al. 2016.
